campaign.name: Prism Garden
campaign.title: Prism Garden restored.
campaign.story: A sleeping prism wakes. Follow its light above the clouds.

campaign.name: Cloud Carnival
campaign.title: Cloud Carnival restored.
campaign.story: The carnival lights flicker. A city below needs your spark.

campaign.name: Electric City
campaign.title: Electric City restored.
campaign.story: Power returns to the skyline. A hidden passage opens beneath it.

campaign.name: Crystal Caverns
campaign.title: Crystal Caverns restored.
campaign.story: The cavern opens in a shower of crystals. Warmth waits beyond.

campaign.name: Ember Foundry
campaign.title: Ember Foundry restored.
campaign.story: The forge releases its last ember. The world turns to ice.

campaign.name: Frost Observatory
campaign.title: Frost Observatory restored.
campaign.story: The telescope finds a signal. An ocean of stars answers.

campaign.name: Cosmic Reef
campaign.title: Cosmic Reef restored.
campaign.story: A river of stars carries the fragments to the citadel.

campaign.name: Prism Citadel
campaign.title: Prism Citadel restored.
campaign.story: The prism opens. Eight forgotten worlds answer its call.

campaign.name: Sunken Archive
campaign.title: Sunken Archive restored.
campaign.story: Lost constellations rise from the deep. Their light points north.

campaign.name: Aurora Passage
campaign.title: Aurora Passage restored.
campaign.story: The aurora folds into a bridge. A forest of turning gears awaits.

campaign.name: Clockwork Canopy
campaign.title: Clockwork Canopy restored.
campaign.story: A thousand mechanisms turn as one. Sand begins to shine.

campaign.name: Mirage Dunes
campaign.title: Mirage Dunes restored.
campaign.story: The mirage becomes a doorway. Thunder gathers on the other side.

campaign.name: Thunder Spire
campaign.title: Thunder Spire restored.
campaign.story: The storm splits. A quiet moon rises above the harbor.

campaign.name: Lunar Harbor
campaign.title: Lunar Harbor restored.
campaign.story: The last ship leaves its mooring. Beyond it, a star falls inward.

campaign.name: Event Horizon
campaign.title: Event Horizon restored.
campaign.story: You cross the darkness. On the far side, every color is waiting.

campaign.name: Dawn Nexus
campaign.title: You brought the dawn.
campaign.story: Sixteen worlds. One unbroken light. You brought the dawn.
